# September 2025 Development Updates #1


[Reclaim Protocol](https://substack.com/@reclaimprotocol)


Sep 12, 2025


**Gentle Reminder** - We're moving all payments to the Reclaim Protocol Dev Tool, and limiting the free tier access. If you're on manual invoices or the free tier, please switch to the Dev Tool’s payment system by


**October 1, 2025** .


We've launched our beta version of Student Verification. A


**new theming system** now allows full branding customization, and


**Overdraft** has integrated Reclaim into their fiat DEX. Plus, we’ve rolled out some minor SDK bug fixes and improvements.


## **Student Verification Beta Launch**


We’re excited to announce the


**beta launch of our Student Verification feature** ! With this release, students can now generate


**verified university credentials** seamlessly. we’re leveraging


**AI** to verify the student’s details.


And here’s the fun part, the


**first student from each university** to complete verification will receive


**rewards** . 🎉


## Theme Customization


Responding to client requests for branded verification experiences, we've introduced a comprehensive theming system that allows applications to fully customize the Reclaim verification journey.


**Key Features:**


-


**Light/Dark mode support** with automatic system detection


-


**Complete visual control** over background colors, images, logos, and loading indicators


-


**Custom branding elements** including verified icons and card styling


-


**Animated backgrounds** support (including GIF assets)


-


**Override-based system** - specify only what you want to change, defaults handle the rest


Want your verification flow to match your brand perfectly? Reach out to us to get early access to custom theming and make Reclaim feel like a native part of your app.


### New Partnership


We’re excited to share that


[Overdraft](https://overdraft.com/) has integrated Reclaim Protocol into their fiat DEX, making fiat <> crypto swaps more secure, verifiable, and seamless than ever.


Here’s how it works:


1️⃣ A user sends fiat


2️⃣ Reclaim Protocol generates a zk-proof of transfer


3️⃣ Overdraft’s smart contract automatically unlocks the crypto


No centralized exchanges. No blind trust. Just cryptography and code. This integration allows Overdraft users to move higher volumes with greater confidence, more security = higher limits.


Don’t miss the


**[cool partnership announcement](https://x.com/OverdraftDeFi/status/1963249678130069538)** the Overdraft team dropped on Twitter.
